Codex_gate_contract.purpose: Review code/patch quality, idempotence, filesystem safety and validation plan if any code/patch is involved.

Hermes_gate_contract.purpose: Review lawful scope, reasoning quality, risk boundary and operator clarity.

construction_steps.goal: Define assignment dashboard schema and canonical panel fields.
Define gate state model for scientific, Hermes and Codex gates.
Define proof, memory and bounded stop artifacts for future execution sessions.
Prepare contracts for Hermes and Codex gates before any code/patch execution.
After gates pass, build a bounded execution surface for the assignment loop.

dashboard_plan_state.operator_visible_summary: Construction plan exists. Scientific/Hermes/Codex gates are required before execution.

mission: Build a visible assignment autonomy loop where SOCC can show task intake, direction, construction plan, scientific/Hermes/Codex gates, proof-chain, memory, stop conditions, and bounded execution readiness in dashboard state.

scientific_quality_criteria.evidence_chain: Every stage writes JSON proof and dashboard status.
failure_modes: Hermes/Codex gate not available or not passed
scientific_quality_criteria.falsifiability: Each PASS must have explicit FAIL conditions.
scientific_quality_criteria.measurability: Each step must output paths, statuses, hashes or gate results.
scientific_quality_criteria.minimal_scope: Only assignment loop surfaces and dashboard pointers are in scope before execution.
scientific_quality_criteria.testability: Every proposed build artifact must have a deterministic read/check proof.

truth_boundary: Construction plan build only. No assignment build execution, patch execution, daemon/background/network, old route resume, or L3 claim.
